dash.protected: Novice — protection from attacks ({{days}} days / up to 2000 acres)
dash.frozen: Duchy frozen — recalculations and attacks suspended
dash.changeRaceWarn: Warning: the current race's army will be disbanded.
dash.generalWaiting: A new general awaits your decision — go to the tab
dash.generalsWaiting: {{count}} generals await your decision — go to the tab
dash.advisorP1: Next to your duchy's name and the coalition name - if you have already joined one - there is information about the number of turns you have available on a given day.
dash.advisorP2: Note - a day in the land of Red Dragon begins after the recalculation at 5 a.m. and ends the next day at the same hour, with another recalculation.

lab.lead: Send a general into the labyrinth. Each recalculation gives you an action budget: 2 points (4 with the Inn at the Red Dragon — then you enter twice). Taking a treasure costs 2 points (the general may be wounded or killed — except for gold), while a general action (searching / changing an ability) costs 1 point and never harms. A higher general level, the 'Fortune' spell and the Explorer trait increase loot and lower the risk. You can carry out a treasure only after the 5th turn of the recalculation. Actions do not cost turns.
lab.doubleEntryActive: Inn at the Red Dragon — entry ×2
lab.treasureLocked: A treasure can be carried out only after turn {{turns}} of this recalculation (and you need 2 action points).
lab.risky: Risk: the general may be wounded or killed.
lab.generalActionsHint: Searching for a general and the Altar never wound or kill. The Altar changes the chosen general's secondary trait at the cost of half his experience.
lab.noGenerals: No available generals (a healthy general at home is required).

drg.title: Dragons
drg.lead: Dragons are powerful beasts that strengthen your army. You obtain them with the Summon Dragon spell (Magic tab) — the mana cost rises steeply with each additional dragon — and passively, luring them with a Portal during the recalculation. The limit is raised by buildings (Dragon Roost → Portal → Ministry of Dragons) and dragon research.
drg.portalActive: active — chance for a dragon each recalculation

gen.hint: Generals arrive randomly when you use turns — the more you have, the rarer new ones appear (when you have none, the next one is guaranteed). You must accept or reject each new general. A Chief increases attack power by his level in percent, a Defender strengthens defense the same way. A general leading an attack returns after the recalculation.
gen.newGeneral: A new general has reported for duty
gen.none: You have no generals yet — use a turn and one is sure to report in.
gen.confirmReject: Reject general {{trait}} {{name}}? A chance for another will appear.
gen.confirmDismiss: Are you sure you want to dismiss general {{name}} (level {{level}})? This cannot be undone.

thf.hint: Thief actions execute during the recalculation (5:00). The success chance depends on the ratio of your thieves to those defending the target.
thf.noWarTargets: No targets — thieves can only be sent against duchies at war or ambush.

mkt.title: Resource market
mkt.sellSummary: You will deposit {{qty}} units of the resource; you will receive {{gold}} gold after the sale.
mkt.buySummary: You will deposit {{gold}} gold toward the purchase.
mkt.taxNote: Market tax: 15% (Accounting research lowers it to 12/8/5%) — paid by the gold recipient.
mkt.errPositive: Enter a positive quantity and price.
mkt.confirmCancel: Withdraw the order? The deposit will be refunded.
mkt.pactsNoCoalition: You can only make pacts with members of your coalition. Join a coalition to make pacts.
mkt.pactsIntro: With each ally you can sign any combination of 4 pacts (one of each type). The trade pact adds the ally's land to your merchants' efficiency; the military, magic and thief pacts help defend your duchy. Check the pacts you want to sign.
mkt.ambasadaHas: The Embassy increased your limit by 1.
mkt.ambasadaBuild: Build the special Embassy building to increase the limit by 1.
mkt.noMembers: No other duchies in your coalition.

pactDesc.Handlowy: The ally's land counts toward your merchants' efficiency (100%, no limit).
pactDesc.Wojskowy: The ally's army left at home helps defend your duchy.
pactDesc.Magiczny: The ally's mages help defend against enemy magic.
pactDesc.Zlodziejski: The ally's thieves help defend against thief attacks.

mag.limitedTip: Limited spell — max 2 per target per recalculation
mag.noWarTargets: No targets — offensive spells can only be cast on duchies at war or ambush.
mag.noMagic: Your race does not wield magic (0 magic books).

atk.title: Attacks — war expeditions
atk.lead: An attack is executed during the next recalculation. You can attack a country no larger than 4× and no smaller than ¼ of your area, not under protection and not frozen. You can attack members of a foreign coalition only while at war.
atk.noUnits: You have no units to attack with — recruit an army.
atk.queued: Attack planned — it will execute at the 5:00 recalculation.
atk.errNoGeneral: Select a general to lead the attack.

general.label: Leading general
general.none: No general available — an attack must be led by a healthy general who is at home.

planned.title: Planned attacks
planned.hint: These attacks will execute at the next 5:00 recalculation. Until then you can cancel them — the turn and the general will return.

rpt.title: Battle reports
rpt.lead: All attacks, spells and thief actions resolve at the 5:00 recalculation. Here you will find the results — yours and your whole coalition's.
rpt.none: No reports yet. Results will appear after the next recalculation.

rank.title: Duchy ranking
rank.writeTo: Write a message to this duchy

mil.dragonNote: They appear on their own or from spells
mil.trainSoldiersTip: Promotes soldiers (Hoplite → Elite 1) each turn. Requires an Altar of Initiation.
mil.trainEliteTip: Promotes elite (Elite 1 → Elite 2) each turn. Requires Special Barracks.
mil.attackPlanInfo: Attacks are executed during the daily recalculation at 5:00.
mil.attackMoved: You now plan attacks in the Combat panel — an attack must be led by a general and executes at the 5:00 recalculation.

eco.wagesHint: Wages are the gold paid to each worker every turn (0–50). Higher wages mean more popularity but also higher cost. Target popularity = wages × 2 (max 100%). Wages of 50 give the full 100% popularity.

res2.lead: Scientists produce Science Points (SP), which you invest in a chosen field. Hover over an icon to see its effect and cost; click an available field to start research. Changing an unfinished field costs 1/3 of the invested SP.
res2.confirmQ: Do you want to start this research?

bld.finishCurrentFirst: First finish the special building currently under construction.

auth.feat3Desc: play with other players, build alliances.
auth.ctaDesc: Registration takes half a minute, and then you rule your own duchy!
auth.infoDesc: Red Dragon is a turn-based strategy MMO set in a fantasy world.
auth.footer: Red Dragon © 2024 - Strategic turn-based MMO game

freeze.title: Freeze kingdom
freeze.desc: Freezing suspends turn processing and protects you from attacks while you are away. You cannot freeze while there are attacks queued against you.
freeze.frozenInfo: The kingdom is frozen — turn processing and attacks are suspended until you unfreeze.

protection.title: Attack protection
protection.desc: As a novice you are protected from attacks, but you also cannot attack. You may give up protection early.
protection.none: Your kingdom is not under novice protection.

reg.title: Registration
reg.intro:
This form will create a new account for you, along with your first duchy.
If you already have an account - don't create another one - log in to it
reg.accountNameHint: You will be shown under it e.g. on the forum.
reg.emailHint: It will not be confirmed, but if you provide an invalid one you won't be able to e.g. recover your password.
reg.kingdomNameHint: The name of your first duchy in the game.
reg.raceHint: The race determines your duchy's traits.
reg.errPwMin: Password must be at least 6 characters!

raceDesc.Człowiek: A versatile race with a large population — good mages, thieves and soldiers.
raceDesc.Elf: Forest dwellers — strong magic (especially white) and effective defense.
raceDesc.Krasnolud: Tough highlanders — the best builders, fewer losses in combat.
raceDesc.Hobbit: The best thieves in the game, surprisingly stubborn defense and good farming.
raceDesc.Nekromant: Hordes of the undead don't eat and take no pay; natural disasters are their specialty.
raceDesc.Dżin: The best mages — none can match them; the only ones who store mana.
raceDesc.Goblin: Aggressors with war machines; +2 turns per day, no magic.
raceDesc.Ent: The best defense in the game and excellent farming; -2 turns per day.
raceDesc.Olbrzym: The strongest attack in the game and building demolition; eats for two, cannot have thieves.
raceDesc.Gnom: Masters of alchemy from the Polish RD server — sappers blow up enemies, but use no machines at all.
raceDesc.Br-Oug: A fertile race from the Polish RD server — +4 inhabitants per acre and the most powerful machines (8 attack), but expensive construction.

pol.title: Politics
pol.leaveInOptions: To leave the coalition, go to the Options tab.
pol.needCoalition: You do not belong to any coalition.

election.title: Emperor Election
election.hint: The candidate with the most votes becomes Emperor. A tie — power stays unchanged.

create.title: Create a new coalition
create.name: Coalition name
create.hint: You do not belong to any coalition. Create your own or join an existing one below.

join.title: Join a coalition
join.hint: You can freely join any coalition with a free slot — no approval needed. Joining automatically leaves your current coalition.
join.none: There are no coalitions you can join.

pps.title: Palace of Final Judgement
pps.desc: A joint construction that ends the era. Requires {{cost}} building material and at least {{land}} coalition acres. A successful attack on a member resets the construction to zero!
pps.onlyImperator: Only the Emperor can start the construction.
